Revises membership of Florida Building Code Administrators & Inspectors Board & Florida Building Commission; revises provisions relating to building code inspection services provided by private provider & private provider firms, including agreement requirements, permit fees, administrative fees, responsibilities of private providers, permitting & inspection documents & reports, timeframes for issuing permits, authority of local building official, notices of incomplete forms, duly authorized representatives, authority of private providers acting as local building official, emergency inspection services, creation of certain forms, systems of registration, audits, immunity, civil causes of action, posting of permits on specified websites, & adoption of a uniformed permitting system.
Provides honorary designations of certain transportation facilities in specified counties; directs DOT to erect suitable markers.

bill_title: Noncriminal Traffic Infractions Causing Vehicle Crashes
bill_desc: Provides specified penalties for certain infractions resulting in crash with another vehicle & requires hearing for such infractions.

Authorizes county or eligible municipality to expend certain funds on lot rental assistance to mobile home owners for specified time period; requires counties & eligible municipalities to develop certain strategies in their local housing assistance plans; provides that lot rental assistance is approved home ownership activity for certain purposes; authorizes certain funds to be provided to mobile home owners for rehabilitation & emergency repairs; removes prohibition that only certain percentage of funds may be used for manufactured housing.

Requiring that a specified amount of communications services tax remittances be distributed by the Department of Revenue by a nonoperating transfer to the Department of Commerce in monthly installments to the Grants and Donations Trust Fund within the Department of Commerce for the Utility Relocation Reimbursement Grant Program; revising the percentage by which a certain amount transferred into the Local Government Half-cent Sales Tax Clearing Trust Fund must be reduced, beginning on a certain date; authorizing a service provider to apply to the Utility Relocation Reimbursement Grant Program for reimbursement of relocation expenses; creating the Utility Relocation Reimbursement Grant Program within the Department of Commerce; providing the purpose of the program; requiring the Department of Revenue to deposit certain proceeds into a specified trust fund to fund the program beginning on a certain date; providing an appropriation, etc.

bill_title: Annual Rate Increases for Coverages by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
bill_desc: Provides that required annual rate increases & limits on such increases for coverages by Citizens Property Insurance Corporation do not apply to new policies issued after specified date & to subsequent renewals of such policies,

Revises requirements for individual to be exempt from completing continuing education; requires Florida Building Code Administrators & Inspectors Board to establish rules relating to special inspectors & their representatives, voluntary inspector categories, plans examiners, inspector certifications, & internship programs; provides internship requirements; authorizes information be given virtually for certain exemption; provides requirements for change of contractor; provides limited liability; requires applicant to file notice of commencement if direct contract is more than specified amount; removes need for certified copy of recorded notice of commencement; revises building permit application form.

Authorizes holders of valid pari-mutuel permit to lease certain facilities to any other holder of same pari-mutuel permit or to any jai alai permitholder when located within specified radius of each other; authorizes such lessees to apply for certain license; prohibits such lessees from operating cardroom or slot machine at leased facility; requires certain jai alai permitholders to conduct minimum number of live performances using their existing permit.

Requires FDLE, in cooperation with specified agencies, to establish & implement Spectrum Alert; develop training program & alert system for missing children with autism spectrum disorder which is compatible with existing alert systems; specifies requirements for training program.

Requires AHCA to provide certain treatments for chronic disease of obesity; provides for coverage of & access to such treatments; authorizes rulemaking; provides construction; requires AHCA to provide coverage through Medicaid reimbursement for diabetes prevention program; authorizes DOH to apply for state plan amendment.

Revises definition of term "roofing contractor"; revises official start date that residential property owner may cancel contract to replace or repair roof without penalty or obligation; revises language required to be in contract, or attached thereto, to replace or repair roof that is executed within a specified time of declaration of state of emergency in certain circumstances; requires contractor executing contract to replace or repair roof of residential property to include in contract, or attach thereto, specified language.

bill_title: Unlawful Demolition of Historical Buildings and Structures
bill_desc: Authorizes code enforcement board or special magistrate to impose fine that exceeds certain limits for unlawful demolition of certain historical buildings or structures; provides that such fine may not exceed certain percentage of just market valuation.

bill_title: Federal Approval for Community Health Workers as Medicaid Providers
bill_desc: Requires AHCA to seek federal approval by specified date to enroll & recognize community health workers as Medicaid providers & to use certain funds & means to secure financing for workers' services; provides guidelines for federal approval; provides reporting requirements.

Requires AHCA to approve drug products for Medicaid recipients for treatment of serious mental illness without step-therapy prior authorization; directs agency to include rate impacts resulting from act in certain rates that become effective on specified date.

Requires DOH, in collaboration with school districts throughout state, to develop informational materials for early detection of Type 1 diabetes for parents & guardians of certain students; provides requirements for such informational materials; requires early learning coalitions to notify parents & guardians of availability of such informational materials.

bill_title: Health Insurance Coverage for CAR T-Cell Therapies
bill_desc: Prohibits specified individual health insurance policies, group health insurance policies, & health maintenance contracts from refusing to contract with in-network health care facilities for provision of CAR T-cell therapies; prohibits such policies & contracts from denying coverage for therapies.

bill_title: Use of State Resources to Influence Statewide Ballot Initiatives
bill_desc: Provides short title, legislative intent, & definitions; prohibits certain entities from producing, disseminating, or funding specified public service announcements during certain timeframe; provides construction; requires certain entities to maintain specified records & make such records available to public.

Authorizes certain individuals to use title "veterinary professional associate"; authorizes veterinary professional associates to perform certain duties only while under responsible supervision of licensed veterinarian; specifies certain education requirements; prohibits such associates from prescribing certain drugs or controlled substances or performing certain surgical procedures; provides that supervising veterinarians are liable for the acts or omissions of veterinary professional associates under their supervision.

bill_title: Standardized Tests for Admission to Medical Institutions of Higher Education
bill_desc: Requires medical institutions of higher education to have standardized admissions test focused on specified knowledge & skills.

Revises & removes provisions relating to institutional controls for mapping purposes; monetary compensation; site rehabilitation agreements; tax credits; brownfield area designations; & participation in brownfield program; prohibits DEP & local pollution control programs from denying specified status or refusing to issue specified order for certain brownfield sites.

Provides sovereignty submerged land leases for Clean Marine Manufacturer facilities; provides competitive grant programs for construction & maintenance of public parking lots for boat-hauling vehicles & trailers.
Revises required instruction in specified life skills to include career readiness, financial literacy, & home economics.

bill_title: Sanitary and Storm Water System Standards
bill_desc: Requires that all sanitary & storm water systems comply with specified state DOT standards for certain elements; provides inspection requirements for such systems; specifies that certain local standards are superseded; provides finding of an important state interest.
Revises criteria for termination of pregnancy during viability.

Requires social media platforms to permanently delete certain information, allow parents or legal guardians of certain minor account holders to view specified information, disclose certain data to law enforcement officers, & prohibit certain minor account holders from using or accessing certain messages.

bill_title: Tax Exemption on Sales of Indigenous Arts and Crafts
bill_desc: Creates exemption from sales tax for sales of indigenous products; requiring the Department of Commerce to maintain a specified registry.

bill_title: Doula Services in Maternal Health Initiatives
bill_desc: Creates Doula Support for Healthy Births Pilot Program within DOH for specified purposes; requires DOH, in collaboration with its maternal & child health section, to implement & oversee pilot program; specifies duration of pilot program, subject to funding; requires pilot program to target specified populations for enrollment; specifies services that will be provided under pilot program; requires department to collaborate with specified entities to integrate doula services into existing maternal health programs & facilitate outreach & service delivery; authorizes department to integrate doula services into existing maternal & child health programs as expansion of pilot program, subject to certain requirements; provides for funding of pilot program.

bill_title: Benefits for Firefighters Injured During Training Exercises
bill_desc: Provides that firefighter & his or her spouse & dependent children are eligible for certain insurance coverage if firefighter is totally & permanently disabled during official training exercise.

bill_title: Law Enforcement, Correctional, and Correctional Probation Officer Benefits
bill_desc: Provides that law enforcement, correctional, or correctional probation officer & his or her spouse & dependent children are eligible for certain insurance coverage if officer is injured in line of duty or while engaged in official training exercise.

Increases amount of lottery retailer bond; authorizes lottery retailer to remit funds to Department of Lottery for deposit in specified bank account in lieu of such bond; authorizes department to act as courier service & contract with third party to provide such service; requires all courier services to have written agreement that conforms to certain requirements & rules; authorizes courier services to store lottery tickets for customers in lieu of delivery; requires such courier services to maintain secure database of all stored lottery tickets & provide specified notice of winning ticket; authorizes such courier services to redeem winning tickets; prohibits portion or percentage of such winning tickets from being charged, accepted, given, or paid to such courier services; prohibits courier service from operating without written agreement; prohibits certain false claims & theft of lottery tickets by lottery retailers, courier services, or employees.

Requires applicant for licensure to submit specified notarized statement to DBPR; subjecting licensed contractor to disciplinary action; requires contractor to return contractee's deposit; authorizes contractor to retain portion of deposit; subjecting contractor to disciplinary action, including suspension of his or her license,; provides criminal penalties for certain violations; requires department to create & adopt by date certain standardized disciplinary form for certain purpose; provides requirements for local construction regulation boards; requires department to record each submitted form in specified automated system; requires specified report by date certain; requires financial literacy standards to include specified content for consumer protection awareness relating to construction contracting beginning in specified school year..

Prohibits person from possessing with intent to promote specified depictions including lewd or lascivious image; prohibits person from soliciting, possessing, controlling, or intentionally viewing depiction including lewd or lascivious image; provides criteria that may be used to evidence actual or simulated lewd exhibition of genitals; prohibits person from soliciting depiction including child pornography; prohibits person from willfully generating an altered sexual depiction of an identifiable person, without consent; prohibits person from soliciting an altered sexual depiction of an identifiable person without consent; prohibits person from possessing with intent to maliciously promote altered sexual depiction of identifiable person without consent.

bill_title: Minimum Age for Firearm Purchase or Transfer
bill_desc: Reduces minimum age at which person may purchase firearm & age of purchasers to which specified licensees are prohibited from selling or transferring firearm.
Limits specified tax deferral to properties with just value of $1 million or less; increases minimum value of tax certificate that may be sold at public auction or by electronic sale.
Requires OIR to provide consumer guide relating to homeowner's insurance on publicly accessible website; specifies requirements for such guide.
Designates October 21 of each year as "Celia Cruz Day."

Revises membership of Board of Veterinary Medicine; establishes application criteria for persons who desire to become & who are licensed as veterinary technicians; authorizes licensed veterinary technicians or technologists to perform specified services under supervision of licensed veterinarians; provides that licensed veterinarians are responsible for all services performed by licensed veterinary technicians or technologists; provides services that only licensed veterinarians may make or provide; authorizes supervising veterinarian to delegate to licensed veterinary technician responsibility of supervising certain tasks performed by unlicensed persons.
Provides exemption from public records requirements for records relating to licensed veterinary technicians until specified criteria are met; provides statement of public necessity.

Removes special assessments as source of funding for certain municipal facilities & services; removes ability of legislative & governing body of county to levy & collect special assessments; removes special assessments as mechanism to finance services or programs rendered specially for benefit of property or residents in unincorporated areas; requires certain ordinances or land development regulations to provide for reimbursement by local government; makes local government responsible for payment of fees or taxes assessed for conservation easements for certain land development projects.

bill_title: Revising How Homestead Property is Assessed
bill_desc: Proposes an amendment to the State Constitution to revise how homestead property is assessed.

Revises method of homestead property assessment; requires assessment be at most recent purchase price or, in case of new construction, cost of construction; requires reassessment to be prior assessed value or specified calculation; requires changes, additions, & improvements be assessed in certain manner; authorizes Department of Revenue to create grant program for certain purpose.

Provides that ignorance of victim's age, misrepresentation of victim's age, & bona fide belief concerning victim's age are not defenses to certain offenses in which victim's age is an element of offense; provides an exception; revises age of victim involved in luring or enticing offenses; prohibits a person from luring or enticing victim out of a structure, dwelling, or conveyance for other than a lawful purpose, etc.

Establishes procedures for impounding motor vehicles involved in fleeing or eluding law enforcement officer; provides conditions for releasing such impounded motor vehicle; provides for payment of impoundment costs & fees.

Requires that specified information has been electronically published without consent in order to constitute violation; removes requirement that an offender intend that person be placed in reasonable fear of bodily harm when making threat or harassing person; increases criminal penalty for violation; creates civil cause of action; requires clear & convincing standard of evidence in such actions.

bill_title: Sentencing of Military Veterans with Mental Health Conditions
bill_desc: Provides that court may impose modified sentence for military veteran with mental health condition rather than set term or mandatory minimum sentence otherwise required by law in certain circumstances; provides requirements; provides exception for certain offenses.
Revises definitions of "cigarette" & "tobacco products" to exclude certain types of products containing tobacco & defines "heated tobacco product."

Revises how rolled back rate is calculated; limits maximum millage rate that may be levied; prohibits higher rate from being levied; requires revenues collected in excess of certain amount to be disposed of in specified manner.

Exempts from public records requirements the partial home addresses & telephone numbers of current congressional members & public officers & their spouses & adult children & names, home addresses, telephone numbers, & dates of birth of, & names & locations of schools & day care facilities attended by, minor children of such congressional members & public officers; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemptions; provides methods for maintenance of exemption; provides for retroactive application of exemptions; provides statement of public necessity.

Revises definition of "infant"; defines "infant safety device"; authorizes certain hospitals, EMS stations, & fire stations to use infant safety devices to accept surrendered infants if device meets specified criteria; requires such hospitals, EMS stations, & fire stations to monitor inside of device 24 hours per day & physically check & test devices at specified intervals; provides additional requirements for certain fire stations using such devices.
Establishes International Aerospace Innovation Fund; requires Space Florida to administer fund; provides requirements for Space Florida & fund.

Authorizes certain seaports to designate no anchoring or mooring zones for certain boats anchored in certain waters for specified time period for specified purposes; specifies boundary limits for no anchoring or mooring zones; authorizes certain seaports to apply to FWCC to establish no anchoring or mooring zones; requires applicant to hold specified number of public hearings; requires commission to consult with other entities; authorizes commission to modify no anchoring or mooring zone boundaries; requires certain seaports to annually review boundaries of approved no anchoring or mooring zones & submit revised application; requires certain information to be included in seaport security plans & seaport strategic plans.

bill_title: Veteran and Spouse Nursing Home Beds
bill_desc: Authorizes certain licensed skilled nursing facilities to request to designate or alter designation of certain beds as veteran & spouse nursing home beds if specific criteria are met; authorizes executive director of DVA to approve such requests if specific criteria are met; authorizes DVA to adopt rules; specifies conditions under which certain state veterans' nursing homes or certain licensed skilled nursing facilities are exempt from having to receive certificate of need from AHCA.

bill_title: Special Alcoholic Beverage Licenses Issued to Residential Condominiums
bill_desc: Excludes certain residential condominiums that sell alcoholic beverages from limitation of number of specified licenses issued; requires licenses to be issued only to person or corporation that manages food & beverage operations; prohibits licensee from selling certain alcoholic beverages for off-premises consumption; prohibits licensee from selling alcoholic beverages after time for serving or consumption of food has elapsed.
Revises definitions of terms "class A air-conditioning contractor" & "mechanical contractor" to include additional services that such contractors may perform.
Revises licensure requirements; provides applicability; exempts certain persons from certain regulations governing practice of acupuncture.

bill_title: Authorized Brokerage Relationships and Required Disclosures
bill_desc: Revises duties of transaction broker; revises duties of such broker when broker is engaged as single agent; revises content requirements for single agent notice & consent to transition to transaction broker.

Requires motor vehicle repair shop to request written crash report from customer; requires shop to prepare & record specified information on transaction form; requires shop to deliver forms to appropriate law enforcement agency; requires electronic transfer of forms to appropriate law enforcement agency by shop; authorizes appropriate law enforcement agency to provide certain equipment to shop; authorizes appropriate law enforcement agency to request original transaction form from shop; provides criminal penalties; authorizes DACS to revoke motor vehicle repair shop's registration; revises items required in written repair estimate.
Provides that persons employed as school social workers are exempt from specified educator certification requirements.

Revises provisions relating to certain trainings & instruction, school district procedures & requirements relating to parental notification, classroom instruction, instructional materials, school personnel training, BOG reviews, state university performance-based incentives, required instruction, DEI program, & general education core courses; repeals provisions relating to personal titles; & revises provisions relating to educator preparation.

Requires each judicial circuit to have circuit judge available at all times to hold & conduct hearings with limited notice; requires certain reimbursement requests be submitted to JAC; removes limitation on arbitrator compensation in court-ordered, nonbinding arbitration; provides alternate method for authentication of oaths, affidavits, or acknowledgments taken or administered by or before any judge.

bill_title: Patient Referrals by Medicaid Managed Care Organizations and Managed Care Plans
bill_desc: Requires AHCA to contract for analysis of Medicaid managed care plan referrals to affiliated organizations; provides requirements; requires report.

bill_title: Taxes on the Rental of Real Property
bill_desc: Repeals tax on rental or license fee for use of real property.

Provides that relatives & nonrelatives who have child placed with them in out-of-home care under Relative Caregiver Program may start receiving monthly payment at time child is placed in such out-of-home care, instead of starting when child is found to be dependent; provides that certain relatives & nonrelatives who have child placed with them may start receiving monthly payments after specified time period.

bill_title: Business Development Incentives for Veterans and Military Spouses
bill_desc: Requires DOS to waive specified fees for certain businesses established by veteran or military spouse; provides eligibility & registration requirements; provides for rulemaking & interagency cooperation; provides reporting requirements.

Repeals provisions relating to sex-reassignment prescriptions & procedures & civil liability for provision of sex-reassignment prescriptions or procedures to minors, respectively; requires covered entity to adopt policy relating to providing notice of its refused services; requires DOH to publish & maintain on its website current list of covered entities & their refused services & develop & administer public education & awareness program; revises timeframe in which physician may perform termination of pregnancy; requires AHCA to provide Medicaid reimbursement for medically necessary treatment for or related to gender dysphoria or comparable or equivalent diagnoses; prohibits AHCA from discriminating in reimbursement on basis of recipient's gender identity or that recipient is transgender individual.
Exempts certain moneys from specified legal process; defines "homeowner savings plan."

bill_title: Statewide Study on Automation and Workforce Impact
bill_desc: Requires bureau within DOC to study economic impact of automation, artificial intelligence & robotics on employment in state; specifies contents of study; requires bureau to consult with specified entities in conducting study; requires bureau to submit report to Governor & Legislature by specified date; requires bureau to conduct this study at specified intervals of time.

Provides discount for certain veteran-owned businesses on required payment of tolls for use of toll facilities; provides requirements for veteran-owned business to qualify for exemption; provides requirements for discount; requires Florida Turnpike Enterprise in coordination with Florida Department of Veterans' Affairs & Department of Management Services to administer discount program; establishes two-year pilot program & reporting requirements.

Revises requirements for the uniform statewide voter registration application; requires DOS & SOE verify certain information relating to citizenship status; requires certain voter registration applicants provide certain identification before voting; requires DHSMV to provide voter registration records to certain individuals; requires certain electors be given provisional ballots; requires certain licenses and ID cards denote individual noncitizens; revises certain instructions & certificates.
Authorizes Governor to execute rapid rail transit compact with specified states, to join Southern Rail Commission; provides form of compact.

bill_title: Tax Credits for Providing Housing for Homeless Employees
bill_desc: Creates specified tax credits for certain businesses that provide housing for employees; provides requirements to receive such credit; provides maximum amount of tax credits that may be distributed; requires department to approve credits before they may be used; requires such approval be done in specified order.

bill_title: Tax Credits for Investment in Rural Communities
bill_desc: Requires Department of Commerce to accept applications seeking approval as rural fund; specifies application criteria; requires rural fund to collect contributions & investments requires growth fund to send documentation of contributions & investments to department; requires department to provide tax credit certificate against state tax liability; provides restrictions on credit; provides requirements regarding tax certificates; provides mechanism to exit program; requires rural fund to submit report to department annually.

bill_title: Insurance Overpayment Claims Submitted to Psychologists
bill_desc: Requires insurance overpayment claims submitted to psychologists to be submitted within specified timeframe.

bill_title: Residential Property Insurance Policy Cancellations, Nonrenewals, and Rate Changes
bill_desc: Prohibits insurers from canceling or nonrenewing, within certain timeframes, policies covering personal residential or commercial residential properties damaged by hurricanes or wind losses; provides that such prohibition applies to flood damages caused by hurricanes; provides that insurer may not cancel personal residential or commercial residential property insurance policies until certain repairs are made or specified policy renewal expires; prohibits certain claims for loss or damage from being covered under extended or renewed policy.

bill_title: Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission Trust Funds
bill_desc: Removes provision specifying type of agreement activities for which moneys from Grants & Donations Trust Fund may be used; removes requirement for administration of Nongame Wildlife Trust Fund; authorizes use of trust fund proceeds for law enforcement purposes; authorizes FWCC to enter into certain agreements with private landowners.

Revises admissions process for veterans treatment court programs; authorizes court, in consultation with multidisciplinary team, to determine eligibility for veterans treatment court programs; authorizes sentencing courts to divert defendants to veterans treatment court programs; requires certain notice be provided to defendants; provides for disposition of probation or community control violations by program participants.

Creates Expedited DNA Testing Grant Program within FDLE; provides for annual award of grants; specifies uses of grants; requires annual report by each grant recipient; & provides rulemaking authority.

Revises definition of term "practice of chiropractic medicine" to include ordering, storing, possessing, prescribing, & administering of articles of natural origin by certain chiropractic physicians; authorizes pharmacists to fill orders of such chiropractic physicians; removes requirement that all chiropractic continuing education be completed in classroom setting; prohibits Board of Chiropractic Medicine from limiting number of hours of continuing education chiropractic physician may complete through distance learning; authorizes board to make exceptions to continuing education requirements during declared state of emergency in this state; specifies who may teach board-approved continuing education courses; requires, rather than authorizes, board to adopt rules; revises grounds for disciplinary action; revises certification requirements for certified chiropractic physician's assistants.

bill_title: Trust Funds/My Safe Florida Home Trust Fund/Department of Financial Services
bill_desc: Creates My Safe Florida Home Trust Fund within DFS; specifies sources of funds & purpose of trust fund; requires that certain percentage of specified sales tax be distributed into fund; requires Department of Revenue to distribute certain funds within specified timeframe.
Exempts from sales & use tax impact-resistant doors, garage doors, & windows during specified month; specifies distribution of certain tax revenue proceeds.

Prohibits Florida College System institutions & state universities from accepting application of or admitting individual who is undocumented for federal immigration purposes; removes provisions relating to waiver of out-of-state fees for certain students.

bill_title: Assault or Battery on a Utility Worker
bill_desc: Defines "utility worker"; provides for reclassification of certain offenses committed against utility workers.

Revises requirements for specified statewide data information program within school readiness program; revises requirements for program's uniform waiting list; revises requirements for determining school readiness program allocation.
Requires DEP, in consultation with water management districts & sewage disposal facilities, to submit to Governor & Legislature reports on certain sewage disposal facilities in state.
Removes requirement that Florida Commission on Human Relations send certain information to certain persons by registered mail.

bill_title: Review of Compensation for Legislators and Cabinet Members
bill_desc: Requires OPPAGA to conduct research, analyze data, & prepare reports containing certain information; requires such reports to be provided to Governor & Legislature by specified date; provides requirements for such reports.

bill_title: Indemnification and Insurance Obligations of Commuter Rail Transportation Providers
bill_desc: Authorizes agencies, in conjunction with the operation of certain commuter rail services, to assume certain indemnification & insurance obligations.
Revises & provides definition of "underground utility & excavation contractor"; & revises definition of "Contractor V."

Provides that certain students are excluded from specified calculations relating to high-performing charter school's facility capacity; authorizes high-performing charter schools to provide part-time virtual courses to certain students; provides funding requirements for such courses; revises authorized uses of Florida Tax Credit Scholarship funds.

bill_title: Vacating Premises After Rental Agreement Termination
bill_desc: Requires landlords to provide certain tenants specified amount of time to vacate premises after delivery of notice to terminate rental agreement before bringing specified action.

Provides legislative intent; requiring the Department of Education to establish a workgroup to update and revise the Florida Educator Accomplished Practices; requiring the department to submit workgroup findings to the Governor and the Legislature by a certain date; requiring the State Board of Education to consider certain revisions and a specified rule by a certain date; requiring the department to develop a teacher examination; requiring the department to submit to the Governor and the Legislature an implementation plan for teacher preparation programs.
Revises criteria for child to receive priority for participation in school readiness program; provides requirements for school readiness program provider to be eligible for specified funding.

bill_title: Young Adults who are Homeless or were in the Child Welfare System
bill_desc: Requires each Florida College System institution & state university, in consultation with State Office on Homelessness, to develop plan to prioritize placement of certain students in residence halls or dormitory residences; provides responsibilities for Office of Continuing Care, Florida College System institutions, & state universities; requires that certain institutions & universities give priority to certain students for housing & work-study opportunities; prohibits institutions & universities from requiring cosigner or guarantor to obtain housing for certain students; requires certain entities to administer certain federal programs & vouchers; provides requirements for administering such programs & vouchers; requires specified entities to document certain actions & provide certain assurances to landlords.

Provides procedures & timelines for objecting, & responding to objections, to sufficiency of evidence submitted by claimants to insurers; requires FDLE to accept certain fingerprints; specifies that certain criminal records must be used by OIR for certain purposes; establishes standards for compensation arrangements & oversight of affiliate transactions involving insurers, managing general agents, & attorneys in fact; requires certain rate filings with OIR from residential property insurers to include rate transparency reports; provides reporting requirements relating to universal life insurance policies; provides authority of OIR over affiliate dividends; authorizes assessable & nonassessable reciprocal insurers, rather than domestic reciprocal insurers, to transact insurance if they maintain specified amounts of surplus funds; provides that attorneys in fact of reciprocal insurers are affiliated entities; authorizes reciprocal insurers to require subscriber contributions; authorizes reciprocal insurers to establish subscriber savings accounts; specifies manner in which impaired reciprocal insurers are proceeded against if they cannot make up deficiencies in assets; specifies manner in which assessments are levied upon subscribers if reciprocal insurers are liquidated; requires reciprocal insurers to maintain unearned premium reserves at all times.

bill_title: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Autonomous Practice
bill_desc: Authorizes certain advanced practice registered nurses to engage in autonomous practice to provide mental health services.

Revises provisions relating to Florida Virtual School including students school may serve; priority to certain students; use of additional funding sources for its education delivery system; board of trustees; accrual of supplemental revenue from direct-support organizations; review & approval of certain expenditures; school's executive director; contracts & agreements; reporting requirements; international assessments; & access to test administrators.

Authorizes DOT to enter into certain construction, maintenance, & operation agreements; specifies that contractors that construct transportation facilities pursuant to Florida Transportation Code do not act on behalf of DOT for purposes of public records requirements.

Specifies age at which applicant for driver license must complete traffic law & substance abuse education course; requires applicant for learner's driver license to complete certain driver education course approved by DHSMV.

Expands list of acceptable forms of identification for certain voter registration applicants; requires that certain ID cards & driver licenses exhibit specified letters to denote that they have been issued to noncitizen.

Requires, rather than authorizing, specified waiver to be in certain form; authorizes claimant to condition waiver on receipt of funds; provides that certain waivers are unenforceable; revises notice contractor must provide to owner of certain real property if direct contract between owner & contractor is more than specified amount; provides that person may not have lien on improved real property if contractor was paid in full under direct contract; provides that person may not have lien on improved real property if contractor was paid in full under direct contract; revises notice that certain lienors must provide to owner of real property before perfecting lien & recording claim of lien.

Prohibits adults from prostitution & specified related acts; requires court to order that person sentenced for certain violations attend an educational program; authorizes judicial circuits to establish certain educational programs; repeals provisions relating to forcing another to become prostitute; prohibits certain acts concerning locations used for purpose of commercial sex; provides that specified testimony concerning reputation of locations is admissible in trial of persons charged with certain offenses; requires reclassification of offenses; requires court to order that certain defendants perform community service, pay for & attend an educational program, pay civil penalty, & receive sexually transmitted disease testing.

Revises applicability for provisions governing conflicts of interest between community association managers or community association management firms & certain persons with financial interest in such associations; removes provision requiring managing entities that perform community association management to comply with certain provisions related to community association management firms; requires timeshare management firms & individuals employed by timeshare management firms to discharge their duties in good faith; exempts such firms & individuals from liability for monetary damages; requires board of administration of timeshare condominium to meet once per year; requires disclosure of certain information annually to certain persons if timeshare management firm or owners' association provides goods & services through specified entities; specifies manner in which such disclosure must be made.

bill_title: Insurer Disclosures on Prescription Drug Coverage
bill_desc: Requires health insurers & HMOs to provide notice of prescription drug formulary changes within certain timeframe to current & prospective insureds, insureds, prospective subscribers, subscribes & treating physicians; requires insurers & HMOs to maintain record of formulary changes; requires insurers & HMOs to annually submit specified report to OIR by specified date; requires health insurers & HMOs & their pharmacy benefit managers to apply payments of prescription drugs by or on behalf of insureds & subscribers toward total contributions of insureds' & subscribers' cost-sharing requirements under certain circumstances; provides disclosure requirements; requires health insurers & HMOs to keep records of third-party payments for prescription drugs under certain circumstances.

Requires party to seek disqualification of court-appointed psychologist before filing an administrative complaint against psychologist; provides for disqualification motions; revises provisions for award of costs & attorney fees in supplemental actions against court-appointed psychologists.

Revises provisions relating to deferral of prepayment of court costs & fees for indigent prisoners for actions involving challenges to prison disciplinary reports; provides for one-year limitation of actions period for certain actions concerning condition of confinement of prisoners; requires exhaustion of administrative remedies before certain actions concerning confinement of prisoners may be brought; provides for dismissal of certain actions involving prisoner confinement; requires showing of physical injury as condition precedent for bringing certain actions relating to prisoner confinement; provides that prison terms for certain offenses committed in conjunction with another felony offense may be sentenced to be served consecutively; revises provisions concerning methods of execution of death sentences; exempts persons working for or at confinement center from provisions regulating use of drones; revises provisions relating to mental health treatment for inmates.

Renames "Florida Health Choices Program" as "Florida Employee Health Choices Program"; revises program purpose & components to provide for sale & purchase of individual health insurance plans to employees enrolled in individual coverage health reimbursement arrangements; removes provisions relating to certain health care service providers, organizations, entities, & vendors, vendor procedures, products available for purchase through program, pricing, risk pooling, & exemptions; revises marketplace process; creates Florida Employee Health Choices, Inc.; provides requirements for DMS; providing for board of directors & membership & terms of office; authorizes corporation to exercise certain powers; provides requirements for board & corporation; revises fiscal year in which corporation's annual report is due.

bill_title: Florida Institute for Pediatric Rare Diseases
bill_desc: Establishes Florida Institute for Pediatric Rare Diseases within FSU College of Medicine; & provides goals of institute; establishes Sunshine Genetics Pilot Program & Sunshine Genetics Consortium.

Creates Occupational Therapy Licensure Compact; provides purpose & objectives; requires member states to meet certain requirements to join & participate in compact; provides criteria that occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant must satisfy to practice under compact; provides requirements for renewal of equivalent license in member state; authorizes active military member & his or her spouse to be deemed as having home state license; requires member states to report adverse actions taken against license of occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant by other member states; establishes Occupational Therapy Compact Commission; provides for jurisdiction & venue for court proceedings; provides membership, duties, & powers; requires member states to participate in exchange of specified information; authorizes commission to adopt rules & bylaws; provides for development, maintenance, & use of coordinated database & reporting system; requires member states to submit specified information to data system; provides requirements for information in data system; provides rulemaking procedures; provides for state enforcement of compact; provides for termination of compact membership; provides procedures for resolution of certain disputes.

bill_title: Pub. Rec. and Meetings/Occupational Therapy Compact Commission
bill_desc: Provides exemption from public records requirements for certain information held by Occupational Therapy Compact Commission; authorizes disclosure of information under certain circumstances; provides exemption from public meetings requirements for certain meetings, or portions of meetings, of commission; provides exemption from public records requirements for recordings, minutes, & records generated during exempt meetings or exempt portions of meetings; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemptions; provides statements of public necessity.

Prohibits a person whose community association manager license is revoked from having an indirect or direct ownership interest in, or being an employee, a partner, an officer, a director, or a trustee of, a community association management firm for a specified timeframe; requires a licensee to create and maintain an online licensure account with the Department of Business and Professional Regulation; requires a community association manager to identify on his or her online licensure account certain information; requires a licensee to provide specific information on his or her online licensure account; requires that such information be updated within a specified timeframe; requires a community association management firm to identify on its online licensure account the community association managers it employs to provide community association management services.

Prohibits notaries public from using specified terms to describe themselves; creates civil cause of action for declaratory or injunctive relief & to recover damages & attorney fees & costs; requires certain businesses or persons offering immigration services to make specified disclosure; creates civil cause of action for declaratory or injunctive relief & to recover damages & attorney fees & costs.

Establishes procedures for licensure by DACS; authorizes sheriff to provide supporting documentation to application for licensure; specifies duration of license; specifies conditions under which license must be revoked; authorizes sheriff to enter into agreement with owner of enhanced firearms training facility to conduct training for school guardian program at facility; exempts enhanced firearms training facility from complying with specified local government requirements in certain circumstances.

Revises application requirements for nursing education program approval; authorizes Board of Nursing to revoke program's approval; revises requirements for annual reports program directors of approved programs are required to submit to board; provides for revocation of program's approval & discipline of its program director; revises remediation procedures; removes provision authorizing board to extend program's probationary status; authorizes agents of DOH to conduct onsite evaluations & inspections; authorizes DOH to collect evidence as part of such evaluations & inspections; removes provision authorizing approved nursing education programs to request extension to meet board's accreditation requirements.

Requires students in specified grades to receive instruction in cursive writing; provides requirements for such instruction; & requires students to demonstrate proficiency in cursive writing by end of specified grade.
Revises provisions relating to affordable housing, property tax exemptions, use of funds from discretionary sales surtax, tax credit, & allocation of funding from FHFC & Live Local Program.

Prohibits specified entities & governmental entities from entering into specified contracts or agreements with foreign principal; prohibits foreign principal from entering into specified contracts or agreements with specified entities & governmental entities; provides criminal penalty; requires specified entities that have entered into specified contract or agreement with foreign principal to register with Department of Commerce by specified date; provides civil penalty; requires entity selling or transferring control of specified critical infrastructure to provide affidavit attesting to specified information to department; prohibits computer software produced or manufactured by specified companies from being used in critical infrastructure located within or serving this state.

bill_title: Pub. Rec. & Meetings/Reports on Adversarial Threats
bill_desc: Provides exemption from public record requirements for certain report on adversarial threats produced by Chief of Domestic Security; provides exemption from public record requirements for notifications provided to owners & operators of critical infrastructure & other assets; provides exemption from public meeting requirements for meetings of Council on Pacific Conflict in which such reports or notifications are provided or discussed; provides for future legislative review & repeal; provides statements of public necessity.

Requires Division of State Fire Marshal within DFS to adopt certain rules; requires division to assist in decreasing frequency of fatalities; requires division to adopt rules relating to education on chemical hazards or toxic substances & mental health best practices.

bill_title: Online Access to Materials Harmful to Minors
bill_desc: Requires developer & covered manufacturer to, beginning on specified date, make specific determinations about covered applications & user, provide certain notices, & provide certain features to parents & developers; provides requirements for devices sold before specified date; requires application store to establish nondiscriminatory practices; provides for enforcement actions by Attorney General; provides affirmative defense; provides limitation on liability for covered manufacturer; revises age verification method used by certain commercial entities to verify age of person accessing certain material; provides exception; requires covered manufacturer to ensure certain statutory requirements are met; authorizes DLA to bring action against covered manufacturers; authorizes imposition of civil penalties against covered manufacturers; removes certain liability & damage provisions for certain commercial entities; removes provisions relating to public records exemptions & OGSR; requires covered manufactures to take certain steps upon activation of device; requires certain websites, applications, or online services to take certain actions based on amount of material harmful to minors found on such website, application, or online service; requires covered manufacturers to comply with statutory requirements in nondiscriminatory manner; prohibits covered manufacturers from taking certain actions; authorizes DLA to adopt rules & regulations; provides preemption.

Requires that order appointing guardian identify persons entitled to certain information upon incapacitated person's death; authorizes that order appointing guardian identify persons entitled to notice if incapacitated person is transferred to medical facility & persons entitled to visit incapacitated person; authorizes guardian to restrict ability of minor ward to maintain certain contacts if it may cause harm to minor ward; authorizes guardian to restrict ability of adult ward to maintain contact with person in certain circumstances; requires guardian to provide ward with notice of change in residential setting in certain circumstances; requires guardian to provide notice to any person identified in order of appointment.

Establishes Joint Legislative Committee on Medicaid Oversight within Office of Auditor; specifies duties; requires Auditor General & AHCA to enter into data sharing agreement; requires Auditor General to assist committee; provides that committee must be given access to certain records, papers, & documents; authorizes committee to compel testimony & evidence; provides that certain joint rules of Legislature apply to committee; requires agency to provide report of specified information to committee.

Prohibits persons from engaging in specified actions relating to consumer finance loans to evade requirements of ch. 516, F.S.; provides that consumer finance loans made in violation of such prohibitions are void & uncollectible; provides construction relating to when person is deemed to be lender subject to such prohibitions.
Requires that certain rules allow tax returns to be timely filed if it meets specified requirements.

Authorizes health plan members, Medicaid recipients, Medicaid enrollees, insureds, subscribers & covered individuals under state group insurance program plans, Medicaid managed care plans, Medicaid providers contracted with AHCA, individual health insurance policies, group, blanket, & franchise health insurance policies & health maintenance contracts to select in-network pharmacists for pharmaceutical services; prohibits reimbursement to in-network pharmacists from being denied under certain circumstances; provides that licensed pharmacists may count toward network adequacy standards for access to services within scope of practice of pharmacists.

bill_title: Real Property and Land Use and Development
bill_desc: Authorizes board of county commissioners & governing body of municipality, respectively, to approve development of housing that is affordable on parcels owned by religious institutions; prohibits counties & municipalities, respectively, from requiring proposed multifamily development to obtain transfer of density or development units, requiring specified percentage of total square footage of mixed-residential projects be used for nonresidential purposes, restricting density of proposed development below highest density, restricting floor area ratio of proposed development below certain percentage of highest floor area ratio & restricting height of proposed development below highest height; requires counties & municipalities, respectively, to reduce parking requirements by specified percentage; prohibits counties & municipalities, respectively, from imposing or enforcing certain building moratorium; requires local government to designate certain property as historic by adoption of local preservation ordinance; establishes state policy to support affordable workforce housing for employees of health care facilities & governmental entities.

Revises amount of annual cost-of-living adjustment; revises how cost-of-living adjustment of benefits for certain retirees & beneficiaries is calculated; provides declaration of important state interest.

Provides conditions for cause of action against certain former phosphate mine sites; provides for certain notice of former phosphate mines for purposes of civil liability; requires DOH to conduct surveys of former phosphate land parcels for purposes of civil liability upon petition; revises applicability of offer of judgment & demand for judgment provisions to civil actions involving an insurance contract; requires award of prevailing party attorney fees in certain civil actions involving insurers; provides specified circumstance under which settlement offer is not good faith settlement offer; specifies applicability of offer of judgment & demand for judgment provisions if prevailing party attorney fees apply; provides evidence that is admissible to demonstrate past & future medical expenses in personal injury & wrongful death actions.

bill_title: Wireless Communications Devices on School Grounds
bill_desc: Prohibits students from using wireless communications devices during school day, rather than during instructional time; requires district school boards to adopt rules for the use of such devices in certain locations or by certain students, etc.

Defines "housing status"; prohibits denial or abridgment of person's ability to access public services solely because he or she is homeless; provides that person experiencing homelessness has specified rights; authorizes court to award certain relief, damages, & attorney fees & costs to prevailing plaintiff in certain civil actions.

Revises policy & reporting requirements for slot machine gaming licensure; prohibits betting on athletic contests with knowledge that results are prearranged or predetermined; prohibits false personation of personnel of Florida Gaming Control Commission; revises criminal penalties for numerous offenses; prohibits trafficking in slot machines or parts; prohibits transportation of specified numbers of persons or persons of certain ages for purpose of facilitating illegal gambling; prohibits certain offenses related to Internet gambling; prohibits specified gambling or gaming advertisements; provides construction; preempts to state regulation of gaming, gambling, lotteries, or any activities described in specified provisions.

Requires that all private employers, rather than only those employing more than specified number of employees, use E-Verify system to verify new employee's employment eligibility beginning on specified date.

bill_title: Limits on Property Insurance Rates Filed with the Office of Insurance Regulation
bill_desc: Limits rates filed by property insurers with OIR to specified percentage.

bill_title: Trust Fund/Creation/Emergency Residential Property Insurance Assistance Trust Funds/DFS
bill_desc: Creates Emergency Residential Property Insurance Assistance Trust Fund within DFS; provides purpose, funding, & administration of trust fund; provides eligibility for trust fund; provides for future review & termination or re-creation of trust fund.

bill_title: Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles
bill_desc: Revises provisions relating to duties of tax collectors, as agents of DHSMV, issuance of certain registrations & licenses, & revocation of certain driving privileges.

Creates Veterans' Rental Assistance Grant Program; authorizes Florida Housing Finance Corporation to provide certain grants to eligible applicants for specified purpose; provides eligibility requirements for program.

Revises initial date of employment for members who have military service & may receive creditable military service; requires DMS to adopt specified rules; revises definition of term "veteran" to include more recent periods of wartime service.

Revises when term of office for certain elected offices commences; authorizes certain officers-elect to have access to specified facilities; revises when specified officers must abide by certain limitations related to approved budgets.

bill_title: Reporting of Student Mental Health Outcomes
bill_desc: Requires OPPAGA to submit initial specified evaluation to Governor & Legislature by specified date; requires office to submit final specified evaluation to Governor & Legislature by specified date; provides evaluation requirements.

Provides exemption from public records requirements for personal identifying & location information of certain current & former personnel & commissioners of Florida Commission on Human Relations & names & personal identifying & location information of spouses & children of such personnel & commissioners; provides for future legislative review & repeal of exemption; provides retroactive application; provides statement of public necessity.

Abolishes certain soil & water conservation districts; transfers assets & liabilities of such districts to DACS; provides that independent special district that grants public access to district lands or water areas for outdoor recreational purposes owes no duty of care to perform specified actions; provides that independent special district is not responsible for injury to persons or property caused by act or omission of such person upon such lands or water areas; provides certain protection to owner of private land if independent special district secures easement or other access right through such private land to district lands or water areas that independent special district makes available to public for outdoor recreational purposes; provides that special district may purchase commodities & contractual services from purchasing agreements of this state; provides that independent special district may require, by resolution, criminal history screening for certain persons; revises qualifications of supervisor of soil & water conservation district; requires DACS to monitor specified soil & water conservation districts & ensure that each district is winding up administrative & fiscal matters in timely manner & using certain practices.

bill_title: Coverage of Dental Services under the Medicaid Program
bill_desc: Revises adult dental services that are paid by AHCA as optional Medicaid services; requires agency to reimburse Medicaid providers at specified rate for covered adult dental services; requires agency to seek federal approval; requires agency to implement statewide Medicaid prepaid dental health program for children & adults; provides requirements for benefits under program.

bill_title: Contracting with Foreign Countries of Concern
bill_desc: Prohibits governmental entities from entering into certain contracts for products with foreign countries of concern if foreign countries have specific ownership interests in those products; removes provisions which prohibit local governments from entering into or renewing specified contracts with certain entities if doing so would give access to personal identifying information.
Requires state departments to employ callback queue system for customers who contact state departments by telephone.

Prohibits certain contracts between athlete agent & student athlete from allowing athlete agent to receive more than specified percentage of student athlete's total compensation derived from use of student athlete's name, image, or likeness; defines "name, image, & likeness collective"; requires DBPR to maintain database of athlete agents which is accessible to public; provides short title; prohibits FHSAA bylaws from requiring student athletes to register compensation with specified entities; authorizes certain high school student athletes to earn compensation for use of their name, image, or likeness; requires students under certain age to obtain parental consent to earn such compensation; prohibits such student athletes from engaging in activities or entering into contracts & agreements that meet specified criteria; defines "name, image, & likeness collective"; authorizes student athletes to consult with authorized advisors; requires students under specified age to obtain parental consent for such consultation; provides requirements for such advisors; provides school responsibilities & requirements.

Revises, provides, & removes provisions relating to recall of board members of homeowners' associations; revises provisions relating to delivery of certain notices; specifies when board member is delinquent in paying assessments; revises & provides requirements relating to elections, recall disputes, arbitration, court actions, & attorney fees; provides financial reporting requirements; requires certain documents be provided to prospective purchasers before executing contract; authorizes prospective purchasers to cancel contract under certain circumstances.

bill_title: Deferred Compensation Plans for Public Employees
bill_desc: Authorizes that certain employees' payable compensation be deducted & contributed to deferred compensation plan through automatic enrollment arrangement unless employee makes certain election; requires that automatic enrollment arrangement be established with default contribution rate; authorizes periodic reenrollment of specified government employees; authorizes periodic resetting of contribution rates for specified government employees; requires that automatic enrollment arrangement provide employees ability to make certain elections regarding contributions; requires that plan provide for default investment into which contributions must be placed under specified circumstance; authorizes counties, municipalities, political subdivisions, & constitutional county officers to adopt automatic enrollment arrangements for specified deferred compensation programs; provides that deferred compensation plan may only include automatic enrollment arrangement upon approval of Legislature; authorizes that certain automatic deferrals be made by payroll deduction; requires that certain deduction of wages or salary of employees be treated in specified manner.
Provides honorary designations of certain transportation facilities in specified counties; directs DOT to erect suitable markers.

Requires DCF to adopt rules to streamline licensure application process for licensed foster parents who relocate within this state; requires such rules to include priority review of applications, expedited home studies & background checks, & recognition of prior foster parent training coursework.
Revising, providing and deleting provisions related to community redevelopment agencies, agriculture, industries and professions, professional licensure and registration, & insurance regulations.

Prohibits court from denying or restricting certain parental rights based solely on parent's status as qualified patient for purposes of medical marijuana use; prohibits presumption of neglect or child endangerment based solely on parent's status as qualified patient for purposes of medical marijuana use.

Provides exemption from specified payment & performance bond requirements for specified entities; extends specific Florida Forever appropriations to be used for purchase of lands in Florida Keys Area of Critical State Concern; revises requirements for specified local comprehensive plans in Florida Keys Area relating to hurricane evacuation clearance time for permanent residents; requires certain entities to maintain building permit allocation systems; provides for award of additional building permit allocations for specified entities; provides requirements for award of such building permits.

Prohibits certain persons from knowingly & intentionally disclosing certain information unless authorized by specified persons; requires persons who receive such information to refer person who provided such information to Commission on Ethics.

Revising the sales and use tax exemption for certain coin or currency; specifying that a person who claims the sales tax exemption bears the burden for determining whether the gold coin or silver coin meets a specified definition; providing a presumption regarding the purity requirements of gold coin and silver coin, etc.

Revises provisions relating to Clean Marine Program, certain competitive grants, safety and marine sanitation equipment inspections, & "Florida Freedom Boater" safety inspection decal; & creates Watercraft Energy Source Freedom Act.

bill_title: Medicaid Presumptive Eligibility For Pregnant Women
bill_desc: Creates pilot program to provide temporary Medicaid coverage to pregnant women who are presumptively eligible for Medicaid; authorizes AHCA to approve certain entities to serve as qualified presumptive eligibility locations; provides application requirements; requires AHCA to prioritize approval of qualified entities located in underserved areas; specifies duties of qualified entities; requires qualified entities to provide written notice of their determinations to applicants within specified timeframe; provides requirements for notice; specifies performance standards for qualified entities; specifies timeframe of presumptive eligibility period for temporary Medicaid coverage; requires AHCA to implement certain procedures that allow for seamless transition from temporary Medicaid coverage to enrollment for full Medicaid benefits; requires AHCA, in collaboration with DOH, to implement outreach program for specified purposes; requires AHCA to seek federal approval to implement pilot program; requires AHCA to implement pilot program within specified timeframe.

bill_title: Deceptive and Unfair Trade Acts or Practices
bill_desc: Provides that persons or entities that take specified actions during transaction for sale or lease of goods or services to consumer commit unfair or deceptive act or practice, enforceable pursuant to specified provisions.

Provides criminal penalties for persons who, with intent to defraud, commit specified acts related to gift cards or use for certain purposes gift cards or gift card redemption information; provides enhanced criminal penalties for second or subsequent violation; provides enhanced criminal penalties if value of violation exceeds specified amount.

bill_title: Religious and Patriotic Expression in the Public School System
bill_desc: Requires specified information to be provided to certain persons relating to religious expression & liberties in public schools; revises requirements for display of state motto, "In God We Trust," in certain schools & buildings.

bill_title: Duties of the Department of State
bill_desc: Revises duties and responsibilities of DOS, including library school programs, State Library Council, Florida International Archive and Repository, Florida Council on Arts and Culture, Florida Artists Hall of Fame, Florida Folklife Council, the Grove Advisory Council, & Florida Historical Commission.

Requires DCF to implement, subject to appropriation, Crisis Care Coordination Pilot Programs in specified counties for certain purposes; provides requirements for pilot programs; requires DCF to contract for independent evaluation of pilot programs & submit report to Governor & Legislature by specified date; provides rulemaking authority; provides for expiration of pilot programs.

Requires landlords of residential real property, developers of residential condominium & cooperative units, & mobile home park owners to provide specified information to prospective tenant, lessee, or purchaser at or before time certain rental agreement or sales contract is executed; specifies how such information must be disclosed; defines "flooding"; authorizes tenant or lessee to terminate certain rental agreements under certain circumstances; defines "substantial loss or damage"; requires landlord or mobile home park owner to refund tenant or lessee all amounts paid in advance for any period after effective date of termination of certain rental agreement; provides that tenant or lessee is still liable for any sum owed to landlord or mobile home park owner before termination of such rental agreement; revises flood information that must be disclosed to prospective purchasers of residential real property.

Authorizes Florida Gaming Control Commission to acquire property without complying with specified provisions; provides enhanced criminal penalties for specified violations; repeals provisions relating to permitting gambling on billiard or pool tables; revises definition of term "instant bingo"; revises provisions concerning applicability; prohibits certain gambling or gaming advertisements; revises criteria for bail determination to specify consideration of certain offenses as source of funds.

Requires background checks on persons involved in firearm sales or transfers; requires firearm sales or transfers to be conducted through licensed dealer; revises requirements for safe storage of firearms; revises criminal penalties; requires firearms be sold by dealers with trigger locks or gun cases; revises warnings to be posted in gun dealerships; requires certain materials to be given to gun purchasers; prohibits specified acts involving unfinished firearm frames or receivers; prohibits certain activities involving three-dimensional printer or CNC milling machine; creates Veteran's Firearm Suicide Reduction Task Force; requiring a report.

bill_title: Carrying of Handguns or Weapons by Law Enforcement Officers Attending Athletic Events
bill_desc: Provides an exception to prohibition on carrying of handguns or concealed weapons or firearms at athletic events if person holds an active certification as law enforcement officer, is attending such events as private citizen, & he or she complies with certain requirements.

bill_title: Online Sellers from Foreign Countries of Concern
bill_desc: Requires online marketplace to record certain information from online sellers to verify online sellers' location; requires online marketplace to disclose to consumers online seller's or online marketplace's location if online seller or online marketplace is in or conducts business or fulfills orders from foreign country of concern; requires online marketplace to hold in U.S.-based escrow account sales proceeds from transactions between Florida-based consumers & online sellers located in or conducting business or fulfilling orders from foreign country of concern; requires online marketplace to hold such sales proceeds for certain period; authorizes such sales proceeds to be transferred to online seller after certain period.

bill_title: Assessed Value Freeze of Homestead Property
bill_desc: Authorizes Legislature to prohibit assessed value of homestead property of certain low-income seniors from exceeding certain amount.

Prohibits assessed value of real property used as homestead by person who has attained certain age from exceeding certain amount if certain conditions are met; requires such persons to apply for homestead in specified manner; requires property appraiser who makes certain determination to serve notice of intent to record tax lien against property; requires property that no longer meets certain eligibility requirements to be reassessed in specified manner.

Expands grounds for reclassification of crimes to include acts of prejudice based on gender of victim; specifies that reclassification occurs if crime was based in whole or in part on actual or perceived characteristics of victim; provides for reclassification of crime if it was based in whole or in part on actual or perceived mental or physical disability of victim.

bill_title: Pub. Rec./Criminal Acts that Evidence Prejudice
bill_desc: Requires AG, rather than Governor, through FDLE, to collect & disseminate specified information; expands public records exemption to include collection & dissemination of data on incidents of criminal acts that evidence prejudice; provides for future review & repeal of expanded exemption; requires AG to publish annual report, rather than an annual summary; provides statement of public necessity.

Revising penalties for employment of unauthorized aliens; requiring all private employers use E-Verify for a specified purpose; authorizing law enforcement agencies to use E-Verify for a specific purpose.

Prohibits expiration of certain building permits issued by county before certain timeframe or specified event, whichever is later; provides that certain persons are not subject to discipline for performing job without applicable permits if otherwise authorized by law; prohibits expiration of certain building permits issued by county before certain timeframe or specified event, whichever is later; prohibits local government from requiring building permits for certain projects; provides exception; requires contractor who performs work without building permit to maintain certain records; requires local government to issue building permit for certain building permit applications within specified timeframe; specifies that certain permit applications are deemed approved by local government; requires local government to issue such permit within certain timeframe.

bill_title: Disclosure of Estimated Ad Valorem Taxes
bill_desc: Requires certain listings to include estimated ad valorem taxes; prohibits current owner's ad valorem taxes from being displayed or used for certain purposes; provides requirements for listing platforms, DOR, & property appraisers; provides protection from liability for specified parties who take certain actions; prohibits certain materials from including specified information; requires, beginning on specified date, department to annually publish formula & certain information on its website.

bill_title: Limitation on the Assessment of Homestead Property
bill_desc: Joint resolution proposing amendment to s. 4 of Art. VII of State Constitution to Authorizes Legislature, by general law, to prohibit consideration of any change or improvement made to homestead property to mitigate flood damage in determining assessed value of such property for ad valorem taxation purposes.
Requires that certain changes, additions, or improvements made through property elevation be assessed in a specified manner; provides alternate assessment in certain circumstances.

Revises maximum number of nominees for Florida Veterans' Hall of Fame; requires DVA to conduct study that evaluates extent to which specified persons are aware of certain existing programs or services; revises requirements of specified report; requires that specified report include evaluation of health literacy of veterans & recommendations on how to increase knowledge of programs & services; requires DVA to ensure coordination with United States Department of Defense for specified purpose; authorizes DVA to engage county & city veteran service officers for assistance; revises purpose of Veteran Suicide Prevention Training Pilot Program; requires pilot program participants to be trained to identify indicators of elevated mental health risk; requires DVA to contract with organization developing & implementing certain mental health training; requires Florida Is For Veterans, Inc., to advise DVA on needs of certain military personnel & their spouses; revises collaborators of Veterans Employment & Training Services Program; requires DVA to develop plan to establish adult day health care facilities; requires that such plans include specified information; requires report to Legislature; revises authorized use of specified percentage of proceeds from sale of specified specialty license plate.
Revises provisions relating certain private schools, FEFP, & minimum base salary for classroom teachers; & establishes K-12 Classroom Technology Grant Program & K-12 Education Funding Task Force.

Provides procedures & timelines for objecting, & responding to objections, to sufficiency of evidence submitted by claimants to insurers; revises requirements for licensing for general lines agents; specifies when adjusters must include their appointment types & names & license numbers if communicating with policyholders by text message; prohibits public adjusters from engaging in certain adversarial conduct; revises circumstances under which insurer or agent may cancel or nonrenew certain residential property insurance policies; revises required statement by property insurers providing preliminary or partial estimate of damage regarding claim; revises required statement by property insurers providing payment on claim which is not full & final payment for claim.

bill_title: Tampering with, Harassing, or Retaliating against Court Officials
